turns.question: How are you feeling about the biology lab now?
turns.speech: Honestly? A little better. Knowing I have a target for Wednesday helps, but I'm still a bit nervous that I'll get stuck on the data analysis part and run out of time before then.

turns.question: Why didn't you tell me sooner that you were worried?
turns.speech: I guess I just didn't want to seem like a whiner. I kept thinking I could handle it on my own, but then it got to the point where I was actually scared I'd mess up the bio lab, so I finally just said something.
